usage_rules.gradients: Avoid full gradients. Use 'glow' effects via box-shadow or radial-gradient overlays.
usage_rules.transparency: Use bg-black/40 or bg-background/80 with backdrop-blur-md for panels.
usage_rules.borders: 1px borders are mandatory for all containers. Use border-white/10 or border-primary/20.

cards.classes: bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] relative overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-xs border border-primary/50 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary/20 text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/30 border border-secondary/50 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-xs
buttons.outline: bg-transparent border border-white/20 hover:border-primary hover:text-primary text-muted-foreground font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-xs

charts.tooltip: bg-black/90 border border-primary/30 text-xs font-mono shadow-xl

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle 'scanline' or 'noise' overlay on the body background.
visual_enhancers.decorations: Add 'corner brackets' (absolute positioned borders) to key data containers to simulate a HUD.

images.description: Dark abstract HUD interface texture for subtle background overlay
images.usage: Apply as a low-opacity background image on the main dashboard container
Use in the 'System Health' or 'Model Status' panel as a visual anchor

assets.icons: lucide-react (Activity, Cpu, Zap, AlertTriangle, Database, Download, Upload, Settings)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is at least 4.5:1 against the dark background. Use 'text-white' or 'text-gray-200' for body.

setup: Install fonts: Azeret Mono and JetBrains Mono.
Update tailwind.config.js with the new color palette (HSL values).
Force 'dark' mode class on the root element.
Create a 'Scanline' component or CSS class for the retro-tech feel.
implementation_order: 2. Build the 'AppShell' (Sidebar + Main Content Area) with the Grid layout.
6. Add the 'System Health' and 'Data Source' panels.
anti_patterns: DO NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it sharp (rounded-none or rounded-sm).
DO NOT use white backgrounds anywhere.
DO NOT make the UI static. It must feel 'alive' (pulsing dots, moving numbers).

general: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮 etc for icons.
component_reuse: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
export_conventions: Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
